items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-29
items.q: I met Sharky, they all used to come over there on Sundays to hear us.

ctx.x: Did you use Biloxi Boys over there?
No, he got boys from here. Mm-hmm. I met Sharky, they all used to come over there on Sundays to hear us. Oh, yeah.
Do you remember a piano player around in Beaumont, mostly, I think he was, called Lazy Daddy? No. He was a colored guy?
